How does Costco Credit Card purchase protection work?
Share
Report Abuse
This question is about the
Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi

Costco Credit Card
purchase protection covers the damage or theft of eligible purchases for up to 120 days after the purchase date. Purchase protection will reimburse Costco Credit Card cardholders for up to $1,000 per item and up to $50,000 per year.
How to File a Purchase Protection Claim with the Costco Credit Card
Call the Benefit Administrator at
1-866-918-4670
, or the number in your card’s benefits guide, as soon as possible after the incident.
File a police report within 48 hours of the incident, if the item was stolen.
Submit a completed claim form within 180 days of the incident.
Wait for a decision. Citibank will notify you of a decision once your claim has been processed.
Get reimbursed for the cost of repairing or replacing the item if your claim is validated by the Benefit Administrator.
Keep in mind that not all items are covered by the Costco Credit Card purchase protection benefit. To see which items are covered by this perk, you can read through the guide to benefits that came with your card.

Does the Costco Credit Card offer extended warranty protection?
No,
Costco Credit Card
does not offer extended warranty protection, because its extended warranty benefit was discontinued in January 2023. Costco Credit Card does have other benefits, though, including rental car insurance, roadside assistance, and zero fraud liability for unauthorized transactions.
If you are searching for a card with good extended warranty coverage, you should consider checking out
Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card
and
Chase Freedom Unlimited®
instead.

Does Costco Credit Card have travel insurance?
Yes, the
Costco Credit Card
does have travel insurance. Costco Credit Card travel accident insurance covers accidental death or dismemberment while traveling on a common carrier, while rental car insurance covers damage to a rental vehicle that results from collision or theft, as long as the purchases are charged to the card.

What are the benefits of a Costco credit card?
The main benefits of a Costco Credit Card are bonus cash back on eligible gas purchases and 3% cash back at restaurants and on eligible travel expenses. Also, Costco Credit Card users don't have to pay an annual fee on top of their yearly Costco membership dues ($65+).
Benefits of a Costco Credit Card
